rationale: Ahmad brings deep expertise in AI-native hardware integration and spatial computing (Vision Pro, Leap Motion) while Sharon's team builds production-ready AI agent infrastructure for accuracy-critical verticals—creating potential complementarity between next-gen hardware interfaces and reliable agent deployment. At a Physical AI hackathon, Ahmad's conviction that AI hardware must be deeply integrated with generative models aligns well with TheAgentic.Ai's focus on production-grade AI systems, making them natural sparring partners for exploring how physical AI devices might leverage robust agent infrastructure.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Sharon — Ahmad leads hardware at Midjourney after shipping Vision Pro at Apple, and Sharon's building production AI agent infrastructure; could be interesting to explore how next-gen hardware interfaces integrate with reliable AI agents.
